head.t: Carl Zeiss wins £228k ophthalmic imaging maintenance deal across Betsi Cadwaladr Wales
head.x: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has direct-awarded Carl Zeiss Ltd a contract to maintain Visual Fields analysers, wide-angle retina cameras and OCT equipment across its Wales sites.
